reader: the first reader, from each run's synthesis card (checkpoint-1.md), against the rubric in method.md fixed before any run was classified; the second reader was given the rubric and the cards only, and wrote its classes before seeing the first reader's

rubric.A: the second-ranked lane supplied something the card says the first lane's version got wrong or lacked, shown by a probe or a failing criterion: a defect fix or a part of the feature
rubric.B: real but optional items: wording, a test, a guard, a structure, a convention
rubric.C: nothing usable, the same items, or no code

firstLaneDefect: whether the card names a defect or a deviation from the approved spec in the first-ranked lane's version that the second lane's version did not have
